name: facet
description: Task-aware MCP tool surface router for coding agents. Routes a token-budgeted tool subset per subtask — 50–65% schema token savings.

tools.name: facet_plan_surface
tools.description: Select a task-specific subset of MCP tools under a token budget. Returns selected tools, deferred tools, and token savings percentage.

tools.name: facet_audit_tools
tools.description: Audit token cost and capability clusters for a tool manifest.

tools.name: facet_register_manifest
tools.description: Cache a full tool manifest server-side to avoid resending large arrays on every facet_plan_surface call.
